text: 哥伦比亚启动了一项旨在积累高达40亿美元国际储备的计划，以促使该国货币从七年高点回落。7月31日，该国央行行长Leonardo Villar宣布了这项决定，就在政策制定者刚刚决定维持利率不变之后。该计划将从8月份初期开始通过每月的看跌期权拍卖进行，首次拍卖的上限为4亿美元。
text_en: Colombia launched a program aimed at accumulating up to $4 billion in international reserves to pull its currency back from a seven-year high. On July 31, central bank Governor Leonardo Villar announced the decision, just after policymakers held interest rates steady. The program will begin in early August via monthly put option auctions, with the first auction capped at $400 million.
